seo.requestTitle: Book a Star — Signature Farewell Memorial | Eternal Repos
seo.requestDescription: Reserve a dedicated memorial star for your loved one, with a private family login to add their story, photograph, and dates whenever you wish.
seo.loginTitle: Family Sign-In — Book a Star | Eternal Repos
seo.loginDescription: Sign in with a one-time link to manage the memorial star you booked with Eternal Repos.
seo.dashboardDescription: Manage the memorial star you booked with Eternal Repos.
seo.profileDescription: A dedicated memorial star, lovingly kept by family, in the Eternal Repos sky.

request.heading: Book a Star
request.subheading: Reserve a dedicated, permanent place in our sky for your loved one — with your own private login to add their story, photograph, and dates whenever you're ready.

about.label: About them
about.placeholder: Share a little about who they were, what they loved, and how they're remembered. You can also add or change this later after signing in.
about.helper: You don't need to finish this now — you can add or edit it any time once your star is active.

photo.label: Photograph
photo.helper: A clear, respectful photograph works best. JPG, PNG, or WebP, under 15 MB.
photo.errorFallback: We could not use that photograph. Please try a different one.

ownerEmail.label: Your email address
ownerEmail.helper: This is the email you'll use to sign in and manage this star once our team has confirmed your booking.

password.label: Create a password
password.helper: At least 8 characters. You'll use this, together with your email, to sign in and manage your star later.
password.tooShort: Please choose a password of at least 8 characters.

confirmPassword.label: Confirm password
confirmPassword.mismatch: Those passwords don't match. Please check and try again.

request.confirmLabel: I understand our team will contact me to confirm the details and next steps for this booking.
request.error: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again, or call us directly at
request.emailTakenError: That email already has an account with us.

success.heading: Thank you — we've received your request
success.message: We've received your request to book a star for {{name}}. Our team will reach out shortly to confirm the details and complete your Signature Farewell package.
success.confirmEmailHint: We've also sent a confirmation link to your email — please click it to activate your sign-in.
success.loginHint: Once your star is active and your email is confirmed, sign in any time with your email and password to add their story, photograph, and dates.

alreadyBooked.text: Already have a star with us?

login.heading: Family Sign-In
login.subheading: Sign in with the email and password you set when booking your star.
login.error: We could not sign you in. Please check your email and password, or confirm your email first if you just booked a star.

reset.intro: Enter the email address you used when booking your star, and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
reset.error: We could not send that link. Please check the email address and try again.

sentState.heading: Check your email
sentState.message: We've sent a password-reset link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to continue.

login.backToRequest: Don't have a star yet? Book one

resetPassword.heading: Set a New Password
resetPassword.subheading: Choose a new password for your family sign-in.
resetPassword.expired: This password-reset link has expired or already been used. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.error: Something went wrong saving your new password. Please try again.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been updated. Taking you to your star…

dashboard.heading: Your Star
dashboard.subheading: Add or update the story, photograph, and dates kept with your star.
dashboard.error: Something went wrong. Please refresh the page, or call us at +91 84486 61338.

noStars.heading: No star found yet
noStars.body: We couldn't find a star linked to this email. If you've just submitted a booking request, our team is still reviewing it — please check back soon, or book a new star below.

dashboard.pendingNote: Your star is still being set up by our team. Once it's active, you'll be able to edit everything below and your star will appear in the public sky.

missing.heading: This star could not be found
missing.body: It may have been renamed, or isn't public yet. If you believe this is a mistake, please reach out to our team.
